sloka: मद्विशिष्टः पुमान्को ऽद्य शक्रो विष्णुरथाश्विनौ ।मामतीत्य हि यं च त्वं यासि भीरु न शोभनम् ।। ७.२६.२५ ॥
transliteration: madviśiṣṭaḥ pumānko 'dya śakro viṣṇurathāśvinau ।māmatītya hi yaṁ ca tvaṁ yāsi bhīru na śobhanam ।। 7.26.25 ॥

translations.english: Who is that man superior to me today, be it Indra, Vishnu, or the Ashvins, whom you, O timid one, would go to, leaving me behind, for that would not be proper?
